tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: a warm off-white that keeps the monochrome from feeling clinical. Dark: a violet-black wall, so the neon reads as lit.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and raised panels on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on paper or surface. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control (use line-strong).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control's edge: inputs, the theme toggle, secondary surfaces that must be seen (3.3:1 on paper, 3.6:1 on surface in light; 4.3:1 and 3.9:1 in dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on paper or surface (6.2:1 on paper in light, 8.5:1 in dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, surface or neon-tint (16:1 on paper in both themes); also the dark block in light compositions. A warm near-black with a faint violet cast; in dark, a violet-tinted white.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Footer, code blocks and dark panels. Always pair with on-graphite text. In dark it sits below paper, so panels still read as a step down.

tokens.name: on-graphite
tokens.usage: Text, links and focus rings on graphite (13:1 in light, 17:1 in dark).

tokens.name: neon
tokens.usage: The signature accent: primary button fills, the neon sign, highlights, one key shape per layout. Use sparingly: one neon moment per screen. Fills, marks and type 24px+ only (4.2:1 on paper in light, 5.5:1 in dark); never small body text.

tokens.name: on-neon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on neon fills (4.6:1 in light). Dark text in the dark theme, where the neon is lighter (5.6:1).

tokens.name: neon-ink
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on paper, surface or neon-tint (7.1:1 on paper in light, 9.2:1 in dark). The readable form of neon.

tokens.name: neon-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, highlight backgrounds, tags, image placeholders. Text on it is ink or neon-ink.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The one focus ring: a 3px solid outline, offset 3px, on paper, surface and neon-tint (6.3:1 or more in both themes). On graphite use on-graphite instead.

tokens.name: neon-glow
tokens.usage: The halo around lit things: the neon sign's text-shadow, hover glows. Never a text colour and never a background.

tokens.name: sign-tube
tokens.usage: The lit tube of the neon sign: its letters, frame and rule. Light: saturated neon so the letters stay legible on a light wall. Dark: a near-white core, with neon-glow supplying the colour.

tokens.name: wall-shadow
tokens.usage: The sign's cast shadow on the wall. Decorative only.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors: message text and the invalid input's border, on paper or surface (6.0:1 in light, 8.2:1 in dark). Always with words; never colour alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation messages, e.g. 'Message sent', on paper or surface (6.0:1 in light, 10.7:1 in dark). Always with words.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles and project card titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The opening paragraph of a page or the hero summary, in ink.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text in ink. Also button and nav labels at weight 600.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, hints and secondary text, usually ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, specs, dates, years and timestamps: the technical voice.

styles.name: sign-beon
styles.usage: The neon sign and the logo only: Beon, a neon-tube face with small breaks where the glass tubes end. Capitals for NEON and PURPLE, lowercase for studio. Never for running text, headings or buttons.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label-to-input gap, tag vertical padding, hairline nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; tight stacks; tag horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding; gap inside a card's text stack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; page gutter on phones. The 8px grid's base step pair.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between related groups; dot-grid pitch in brand patterns.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop; footer padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section spacing on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom space on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, checkboxes, sign brackets.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, the theme toggle, status messages.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, large panels, media and brand blocks.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Hover on the primary button: the neon switching on. The only shadow on controls; borders do the rest.

tokens.name: glow-lg
tokens.usage: Hover and focus-within on project cards.
